start: Profile tab, no profile photo yet (the first letter of the name shows)

steps.action: Tap the pencil 'Edit profile' at the top
user_sees: The Edit profile page with a round picture and the button 'Add photo'
must_not: Another member's photo
A broken picture

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Profile photo' with 'Take a photo' and 'Choose from gallery'
must_not: 'Remove photo' when there is no photo

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from gallery', pick a picture and crop it square
user_sees: 'Saving the photo…' on the button, then the new picture and 'Change photo'
must_not: The old picture kept with no message
The button working twice while saving

steps.action: Go back to the Profile tab
user_sees: The new photo at the top of the Profile
must_not: The first letter still shown

steps.action: Tap 'Change photo', then 'Take a photo', take and crop it
user_sees: The new photo in the round picture
must_not: Two copies of the photo kept
The old photo file left behind

steps.action: Android closes MettleUp behind the camera; open MettleUp again
user_sees: The photo just taken is kept and shown
must_not: The photo lost after the restart

user_sees: The same Edit profile page with the photo button
must_not: A different profile page with other values

start: Edit profile page, camera permission refused before

user_sees: Message 'Camera not allowed' with 'Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone’s settings, or choose a photo instead.'
must_not: A crash
A photo saved anyway

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from gallery' and cancel the picker
must_not: The photo removed
'Couldn’t change the photo' after a plain cancel

start: Edit profile page with a profile photo

user_sees: The round picture shows the first letter again and the button says 'Add photo'
must_not: The photo still on the Profile tab
The picture deleted from the phone gallery
The removed photo coming back

start: Member with a profile photo, signed in to a cloud copy

steps.action: Look at the gym's view of the member and the cloud copy
user_sees: The photo stays on this phone only; the gym's own member photo is a separate desk photo
must_not: The profile photo sent to MettleUp's server or the gym

user_sees: The profile photo gone; the first letter shows
must_not: The photo file left in the app's folder

steps.action: Restore the backup on a new phone
user_sees: The first letter until a photo is picked again
must_not: A broken picture from an old path
